title: Rubbermaid Antimicrobial Sink Dish Drainer
text: Rubbermaid Antimicrobial Sink Dish Drainer. I purchased this to replace a set that was nearly identical set... my old set wore out.  It is the perfect size for my tiny kitchen sink area.  It comes with a utensil holder, a suction cupped sponge holder and a brush. It is black as shown in the photos. While this set "looked" like my old set, it didn't function the same way. In order to properly drain the water from the bottom tray, you need the bottom tray to be lifted a bit (the old one did too), so I have a non-skid block my husband made to provide a slight lift for drainage. It's only about 1 1/2 inches. So why 3 stars?  The problem with the new set is that with the drain lift, the rack slides off the bottom tray!!  Why?  Well.. the new tray has an almost teflon feel to it! Obviously it's not actually coated but it looks and feels like it.  It is hard, molded plastic, like the old one and the "feet" of the basket are exactly the same as the old set... Is the sliding problem part of the "antimicrobial" benefit?  I'd rather just properly clean!!  Anyway -  I had to come up with a solution that would allow me to still clean it.  I included a picture so you see my "fix" and also the surface of the bottom tray for yourself.  I used a couple of small floor chair glide tabs to provide a "stop" for the basket without effecting the drainage.  Disappointing that the "feet" are more grippy or the tray wasn't so slippery. Disappointing, but not worth returning. It arrived quickly, well packed and in good condition (I have prime).  I always update my reviews if new info would be helpful.

product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid Sink Set with Dish Drying Rack, Drainboard, Sponge Caddy, and Brush, Red, 4-Pieces
features: This set includes a small wire dish drainer, a small drain board, a sponge caddy and a kitchen brush
The drainer organizes your dishes while drying
The drain board has a sloped design to direct water into the sink keeping counters dry
The sponge caddy organizes your sponges and brushes in the sink
The wire dish drainer is 14.31 x 12.49 x 5.39 inches and the small drain board is 14.38 x 15.38 x 1.3 inches
description: This dish rack sinkware set has everything you need for washing your dishes minus the soap, water and dirty dishes! It includes a dish drainer and drain board to make drying dishes a breeze. The sponge caddy organizes your sponges and brushes in your sink. The kitchen brush’s small head makes it perfect for cleaning in tight places. 4 Piece, Red, Sinkware Set, Consists Of: Drain Board Model 1180, Twin Size Dish Drainer Model 6008, Sponge Caddy Model 1F73 & Scrub Brush, Dimensions 16.1"L x 14.9"W x 6.7"H.
